definition.name: A2_2_PRIOR_MATCHED
definition.role: +-level world, Gaussian prior with matched mean/variance (= R2-2 F2)

definition.name: A2_2C_MATCHED_CLEAN
definition.role: A2-2 with the two terms the filter cannot represent removed from the world (wheelbase=0, slip off)

definition.name: A2_3_GAUSS_LEVEL
definition.role: model-matched world: calibration drawn from the filter prior (level sigma), wheelbase 0, slip off

definition.name: A2_3D_GAUSS_DEFAULT
definition.role: model-matched world with the default (code) calibration prior

definition.name: ORACLE_CAL
definition.role: true calibration and wheelbase known (control, not a method)

definition.name: ODOM_OFF
definition.role: B0 world, odometry heading update disabled

definition.name: A2_3_ODOM_OFF
definition.role: model-matched, prediction only (pure propagation linearisation test)

definition.name: NO_C
definition.role: DIAGNOSTIC: shared-input cross-covariance C removed from the update

definition.name: Q_TRUE
definition.role: DIAGNOSTIC oracle: Q from the true increments
